explanation: Insulinoma is an endogenous insulin-secreting tumor. It causes hypoglycemia with high insulin and high C-peptide levels. Exogenous insulin use would cause high insulin but low C-peptide, which is not seen here. CNS symptoms (confusion, altered mental status. are classic features of hypoglycemia.
